Name: Mew
English_Description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

Name: Jirachi
English_Description: It is said to wake up for just seven days every 1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish.

Name: Glalie
English_Description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

Name: Celebi
English_Description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

Name: Phione
English_Description: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

Name: Shuckle
English_Description: It stores berries in its shell. The berries mix with its body fluids to become delicious juices.

Name: Blissey
English_Description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

Name: Deoxys (Attack Forme)
English_Description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

Name: Stakataka
English_Description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

Name: Guzzlord
English_Description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
